text:
2.11 筛选潜在成分靶点

rm(list = ls())

# pubchem: all
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.pubchem.RData")
pubchem <- targets.pubchem |> dplyr::select(-Score)


# stitch: Score > 0.7
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.stitch.RData")
stitch <- targets.stitch |>
  dplyr::filter(Score>=0.7) |>
  dplyr::select(-Score)

save(stitch, file = "data/qfd_targets/stitch.RData")
write.xlsx(stitch |> distinct(PROTEINID), file = "data/qfd_targets/stitch.xlsx")


# TCMSP: all
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.tcmsp.RData")
tcmsp <- targets.tcmsp |> dplyr::select(-Score.SVM)

save(tcmsp, file = "data/qfd_targets/tcmsp.RData")
write.xlsx(tcmsp |> distinct(Entry), file = "data/qfd_targets/tcmsp.xlsx")


# HERB2: all
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.herb2.RData")
herb2 <- targets.herb2 |> dplyr::select(-Mining)

save(herb2, file = "data/qfd_targets/herb2.RData")
write.xlsx(herb2 |> distinct(Symbol), file = "data/qfd_targets/herb2.xlsx")

# Swiss: Probability>=0.1
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.swiss.RData")
swiss <- targets.swiss |>
  dplyr::filter(Probability>=0.1) |>
  dplyr::select(-Probability)

save(swiss, file = "data/qfd_targets/swiss.RData")
write.xlsx(swiss |> distinct(Uniprot.ID), file = "data/qfd_targets/swiss.xlsx")

# Super-PRED: Probability>="80%" (+ `Model accuracy` >= "95%")
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.super.RData")
super <- targets.super |>
  mutate(Prob_num = as.numeric(str_remove(Probability,"%"))) |>
  dplyr::filter((Prob_num>=80 ) | Class == "validated") |>
  dplyr::select(-Probability,-`Model accuracy`, -Prob_num)

save(super, file = "data/qfd_targets/super.RData")
write.xlsx(super |> distinct(Uniprot.ID), file = "data/qfd_targets/super.xlsx")
  
# PharmMapper: `Norm Fit` >= 0.70
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.pharm.RData")
pharm <- targets.pharm |> 
  dplyr::filter(`Norm Fit` >= 0.7) |>
  dplyr::select(-`Norm Fit`)

save(pharm, file = "data/qfd_targets/pharm.RData")
write.xlsx(pharm |> distinct(Uniplot), file = "data/qfd_targets/pharm.xlsx")

# SEA: P.Value < 0.01、Max.Tc >= 0.3
load("data/qfd_targets/targets.sea.RData")
sea <- targets.sea |> 
  dplyr::filter(P.Value < 0.01 & Max.Tc >= 0.3) |>
  dplyr::select(-P.Value, -Max.Tc)

save(sea, file = "data/qfd_targets/sea.RData")
write.xlsx(sea |> distinct(Target.ID), file = "data/qfd_targets/sea.xlsx")

title: 原始数据预处理
text:
2.12 合并潜在成分靶点

load("data/qfd_targets/ingredients.std.RData")

ingredients.targets <- rbind(
  pubchem_std,
  stitch_std,
  tcmsp_std,
  herb2_std,
  swiss_std,
  super_std,
  pharm_std,
  sea_std
) |> 
  group_by(No., Abbreviation, Ingredient, Type, PubChem.CID, Symbol) |>
  summarise(
    Source.Sum = paste(Source, collapse = ";"),  
    Class.Sum = paste(Class, collapse = ";"), 
    Count = n_distinct(Source),      
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Class = case_when(
    str_detect(Class.Sum, "validated") ~ "validated",
    TRUE ~ "predicted"
  )) |>
  mutate(Symbol = trimws(Symbol))

ingredients.targets.filter <-  ingredients.targets |>
  dplyr::filter(Class == "validated" | (Class == "predicted" & Count>=2))

save(ingredients.targets,ingredients.targets.filter, file =  "data/qfd_targets/ingredients_targets.RData")

title: 原始数据预处理
text:
3.1 DisGeNet v25.4 (2025-12-15更新/2025-12-20检索)

rm(list = ls())

res <- disease2gene(disease = "UMLS_C0018801",     database = "CURATED",
    score = c(0,1) 
)

hf <- res@qresult

res <- disease2gene(disease = "UMLS_C0018802",     database = "CURATED",
    score = c(0,1) 
)

chf <- res@qresult

disgenet <- rbind(hf,chf) |>
  filter(geneNcbiType == "protein-coding") |>
  group_by(gene_symbol) |>
  summarise(
    max_normalized_score = max(normalized_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Count = n_distinct(disease_name),
    Source = "DisGeNet V25.4",
    .groups = "drop"
  )

nrow(disgenet)

save(hf,chf, file = "data/chf_targets/raw.RData")

save(disgenet,file = "data/chf_targets/disgenet.RData")

write.xlsx(disgenet, file = "data/chf_targets/disgenet.xlsx")
